text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of summer camp.
It's a time
of intense training where
racers can improve their
skills.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We're here! I think we beat the bus that
everyone
else is coming in!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Oh, geez, Trainer! Stop making that
face—look
sharp!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

with
